issue_request: FHIR-33990 asked for a DiagnosticReport search parameter for imagingStudy. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution chose the generic name study and requested search over GenomicStudy or ImagingStudy.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-33990 was found. Commit 5dff1ff5ad added SearchParameter DiagnosticReport-study with expression DiagnosticReport.study and made DiagnosticReport.study the generic study reference with ImagingStudy and GenomicStudy targets during the R5 application trail.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport and ImagingStudy remain active current-build resources, and source/fhir.ini maps the former DiagnosticReport.imagingStudy to DiagnosticReport.study. Later source history removed GenomicStudy from active core configuration and from DiagnosticReport.study, and later issues FHIR-54164 and FHIR-57361 support the current interpretation after GenomicStudy moved to Incubator. The closely related FHIR-37802 reconciliation is already present on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current DiagnosticReport search-parameter source already defines DiagnosticReport-study with code study, type reference, and expression DiagnosticReport.study, so adding a duplicate imaging-study parameter or restoring GenomicStudy would be inconsistent with later source history and build scope.
